description: Latest breaking stories from The Veil Press, newest first: title, slug, url, published time, summary, key fact, cover and share image URLs, tags and sources.

include_archived.description: Include stories older than 7 days (default true).

limit.description: How many stories to return (1-50, default 10).

since.description: Only stories published after this ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-10-26T00:00:00Z.

tag.description: Only stories with this tag (case-insensitive), e.g. Treasury.

name: list_breaking_stories
title: List breaking stories
